method: Built-in image_gen (one call per missing view), reference-guided product-mockup generation

limitations: These are newly generated matching alternate views, not recovered historical photographs. Unseen rear construction is inferred from the original front view; visual garment identity, colors, cut and studio style were checked against the references.
conversion: Sharp WebP quality 88; 960px base plus 400px and 800px widths, aspect ratio retained. No artistic editing.
existingAssets: All existing reference assets retained; conversion refused to overwrite existing destinations.
